answer: Each identity needs one registered buoy anchored beside a reef, streaming for 90 days before trading opens. Hourly it reports each light zephyr and every small ripple under a serial tied to that identity. Neighbors compare readings, so a buoy reporting calm water while three neighbors report a storm loses standing and 200 tokens. Faking 1,000 identities needs 1,000 buoys at 850 dollars each plus 600 dollars per trip, over 1.4 million dollars. Like a reef grown only where real currents passed, this record grows only from real hardware, so a copy arrives with no tide behind it.
